name: dismissible-notice
title: Dismissible notice
description: A tip or notice card people can close for good: it remembers the dismissal, can return after N days, and comes back when its version changes.
docs: id names the notice in localStorage (rhs-ui:dismissed:<id>); version and remindAfterDays decide when a dismissal stops counting. Where storage throws, the dismissal lives in memory for the session. The card is drawn after the page is live, never in the server HTML, and it folds away on close, instantly under reduced motion. useDismissed(id, options) returns { dismissed, dismiss, restore } for anything else that should stay closed: pass dismiss to Banner's onDismiss and render the banner while dismissed is false.
